{"1":{"source":"--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local Knit = require(RS.Packages.Knit)
local Appearance = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.PetAppearance)

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local REALM_CENTER = Vector3.new(2000, 30, 2000)
local slots: { any } = {}
local butterflies: { BasePart } = {}
local dataSnapshot: any = nil

local function realm(): Model?
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("PetGardenRealm") :: any
end

local function getData(): any
	local ok, ctrl = pcall(function() return Knit.GetController("DataController") end)
	if not ok or not ctrl then return nil end
	local ok2, d = pcall(function() return (ctrl :: any):GetPlayerData() end)
	if not ok2 then return nil end
	return d
end

local function findPet(data: any, uid: string): any
	for _, p in ipairs(data.Pets or {}) do if p.UID == uid then return p end end
	return nil
end

local function ensureSlot(i: number): any
	if slots[i] then return slots[i] end
	local r = realm()
	if not r then return nil end
	local plot = r:FindFirstChild("GardenPlot" .. tostring(i))
	if not plot then return nil end
	local pad = plot:FindFirstChild("PetPad")
	local anchors: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(plot:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name:match("^CropAnchor") then table.insert(anchors, child) end
	end
	table.sort(anchors, function(a: BasePart, b: BasePart): boolean return a.Name < b.Name end)
	local folderVisuals = Instance.new("Folder")
	folderVisuals.Name = "WorkVisuals"
	folderVisuals.Parent = plot
	local crops: { BasePart } = {}
	for k, anchor in ipairs(anchors) do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "CropStage" .. tostring(k)
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.8, 0.6)
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 120)
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(anchor.Position)
		part.Parent = folderVisuals
		table.insert(crops, part)
	end
	local bill = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bill.Name = "PlotStatus"
	bill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 64)
	bill.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	bill.AlwaysOnTop = false
	bill.MaxDistance = 90
	local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
	local adornee: Instance? = sign and sign:IsA("BasePart") and sign or pad
	if adornee then bill.Adornee = adornee end
	bill.Parent = plot
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "StatusText"
	text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	text.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 58, 49)
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	text.TextSize = 14
	text.TextWrapped = true
	text.Parent = bill
	local sparkAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
	sparkAttach.Name = "ReadySparkles"
	local padPart = pad and pad:IsA("BasePart") and pad or nil
	if padPart then
		sparkAttach.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		sparkAttach.Parent = padPart
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Name = "ReadyGlow"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 130))
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.16)
		emitter.LightEmission = 0.5
		emitter.Parent = sparkAttach
	end
	local slot = {
		Index = i,
		Plot = plot,
		Pad = pad,
		Crops = crops,
		Billboard = bill,
		StatusText = text,
		Visuals = folderVisuals,
		PetModel = nil :: any,
		PetUID = nil :: any,
		Seed = math.random() * 10,
	}
	slots[i] = slot
	return slot
end

local function setCrops(slot: any, frac: number, ready: boolean)
	local stage = 0
	if frac < 0.25 then stage = 0
	elseif frac < 0.5 then stage = 1
	elseif frac < 0.75 then stage = 2
	elseif frac < 1 then stage = 3
	else stage = 4 end
	for k, part in ipairs(slot.Crops) do
		local p = part :: BasePart
		if stage == 0 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.7, 0.4)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 130)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
		elseif stage == 1 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 1, 0.7)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 185, 105)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
		elseif stage == 2 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1.3, 1)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 150, 60)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		elseif stage == 3 then
			p.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.4, 1.2)
			p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 110, 60)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		else
			p.Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1.5, 1.4)
			p.Color = (k % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(240, 140, 30) or Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 60)
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		end
		p.Transparency = 0
	end
	local padPart = slot.Pad and slot.Pad:IsA("BasePart") and slot.Pad or nil
	if padPart then
		local attach = padPart:FindFirstChild("ReadySparkles")
		if attach then
			local emitter = attach:FindFirstChild("ReadyGlow")
			if emitter and emitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				emitter.Rate = ready and 4 or 0
			end
		end
	end
end

local function clearSlot(slot: any)
	if slot.PetModel then (slot.PetModel :: Model):Destroy() slot.PetModel = nil end
	slot.PetUID = nil
	for _, part in ipairs(slot.Crops) do (part :: BasePart).Transparency = 1 end
	local padPart = slot.Pad and slot.Pad:IsA("BasePart") and slot.Pad or nil
	if padPart then
		local attach = padPart:FindFirstChild("ReadySparkles")
		if attach then
			local emitter = attach:FindFirstChild("ReadyGlow")
			if emitter and emitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then emitter.Rate = 0 end
		end
	end
	slot.StatusText.Text = "EMPTY PLOT ➕"
end

local function refreshState()
	dataSnapshot = getData()
	local r = realm()
	if not r then return end
	local entries: { any } = {}
	if dataSnapshot and type(dataSnapshot.GardenExpeditions) == "table" then
		for _, e in ipairs(dataSnapshot.GardenExpeditions) do table.insert(entries, e) end
		table.sort(entries, function(a: any, b: any): boolean return (a.StartedAt or 0) < (b.StartedAt or 0) end)
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local slot = ensureSlot(i)
		if not slot then continue end
		local entry = entries[i]
		if not entry then
			if slot.PetUID ~= nil then clearSlot(slot) end
			slot.StatusText.Text = "EMPTY PLOT ➕"
			continue
		end
		local now = os.time()
		local duration = math.max(1, entry.Duration or 60)
		local left = math.max(0, (entry.ReadyAt or now) - now)
		local frac = math.clamp((duration - left) / duration, 0, 1)
		local ready = left <= 0
		setCrops(slot, frac, ready)
		local pet = dataSnapshot and findPet(dataSnapshot, entry.UID) or nil
		local wantKey = entry.UID .. "|" .. (pet and (pet.PetId .. tostring(pet.Cosmetic)) or "gone")
		if slot.PetUID ~= wantKey then
			if slot.PetModel then (slot.PetModel :: Model):Destroy() slot.PetModel = nil end
			if pet then
				local ok, model = pcall(function() return Appearance.Create(pet) end)
				if ok and model then
					(model :: Model).Parent = workspace
					slot.PetModel = model
				end
			end
			slot.PetUID = wantKey
		end
		local mm = math.floor(left / 60)
		local ss = left % 60
		local label = (pet and entry.PetId or "Pet") .. "\n" .. string.format("%02d:%02d", mm, ss)
		if ready then label = "READY TO HARVEST ✨" end
		slot.StatusText.Text = label
	end
end

local function nearRealm(): boolean
	local char = localPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - REALM_CENTER).Magnitude < 260
end

-- Butterflies: 3 tiny wanderers, only animate near realm.
local function ensureButterflies()
	local r = realm()
	if not r or #butterflies > 0 then return end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = "Butterfly" .. tostring(i)
		p.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.4)
		p.Color = if i == 1 then Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220) elseif i == 2 then Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 150)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Position = REALM_CENTER + Vector3.new(-10 + i * 8, 34, 10)
		p.Parent = r
		table.insert(butterflies, p)
	end
end

Knit.OnStart():andThen(function()
	local ok, ctrl = pcall(function() return Knit.GetController("DataController") end)
	if ok and ctrl then
		(ctrl :: any).Changed:Connect(function() refreshState() end)
	end
	refreshState()
end):catch(function() end)

-- Portal prompt -> same secure Return function as UI.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local r = realm()
		if r then
			local gate = r:FindFirstChild("ReturnPortal", true)
			if gate and gate:IsA("BasePart") then
				local prompt = gate:FindFirstChild("ReturnPrompt")
				if prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and not prompt:GetAttribute("Hooked") then
					prompt:SetAttribute("Hooked", true)
					prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
						local folder = RS:FindFirstChild("AnimalKingdomRemotes")
						local req = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("UIRequest")
						if req and req:IsA("RemoteEvent") then (req :: RemoteEvent):FireServer("ReturnGarden", {}) end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		refreshState()
		ensureButterflies()
	end
end)

local elapsed = 0
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not nearRealm() then return end
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 1 / 30 then return end
	local delta = elapsed
	elapsed = 0
	local t = os.clock()
	for _, slot in pairs(slots) do
		local model = slot.PetModel
		if not model then continue end
		local pad = slot.Pad
		if not pad or not pad:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
		local seed = slot.Seed or 0
		local wander = Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 0.5 + seed) * 2.2, 0, math.cos(t * 0.4 + seed * 1.7) * 1.6)
		local hop = math.abs(math.sin(t * 2.2 + seed * 3)) * 0.35
		local bob = math.sin(t * 3 + seed) * 0.12
		local base = (pad :: BasePart).Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6 + hop + bob, 0) + wander
		local faceAngle = math.sin(t * 0.3 + seed * 2) * 1.2
		local target = CFrame.new(base) * CFrame.Angles(0, faceAngle, math.sin(t * 1.4 + seed) * 0.06)
		local current = (model :: Model):GetPivot()
		if (current.Position - target.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
			(model :: Model):PivotTo(target)
		else
			(model :: Model):PivotTo(current:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-6 * delta)))
		end
	end
	for i, b in ipairs(butterflies) do
		local c = REALM_CENTER + Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 0.4 + i * 2.1) * 22, 4.5 + math.sin(t * 0.9 + i) * 1.2, math.cos(t * 0.33 + i * 1.3) * 22)
		b.Position = b.Position:Lerp(c, 1 - math.exp(-2 * delta))
	end
end)
